title: Self-Evolving Static Analysis via LLM Pseudo-Labeling
title_zh: 基于 LLM 伪标注的自进化静态分析

paragraphs.en: Security bugs often slip past static analysis not because they are impossible to detect, but because detection rules have not yet been written for the code in front of us. New frameworks, APIs, and coding idioms continually create such gaps, leaving developers to discover failures and manually encode new rules.
paragraphs.zh: 安全缺陷之所以常常躲过静态分析，并不是因为它们无法被检测到，而是因为尚未针对我们面前的代码编写相应的检测规则。 新的框架、API 和编码习惯不断造成这样的空白，使得开发者只能通过发现故障来手动编写新规则。

paragraphs.en: We present SESAA, a framework in which an LLM ( LLM ) agent starts from no rules and iteratively evolves a set of readable and auditable Joern queries. The agent receives feedback only from a second LLM critic, which inspects flagged and unflagged code to identify likely false alarms and suspected misses, without access to ground-truth labels. The agent then uses this feedback to revise its queries.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SESAA，这是一个让大语言模型（LLM）智能体从零规则出发、迭代演化出一组可读且可审计的 Joern 查询的框架。 该智能体仅从第二个 LLM 评审者那里获得反馈，评审者检查被标记和未被标记的代码以识别可能的误报和疑似漏报，且无法访问真实标签。 智能体随后利用这些反馈来修订其查询。

paragraphs.en: On the OWASP Benchmark for Python, SESAA reaches a mean F 1 F_{1} of 0.742 0.742{} across 8 8{} independent runs, well above the default configurations of five widely used tools and comparable to the strongest of them once it is tuned with access to ground-truth labels that SESAA never sees. paragraphs.en: Static-analysis tools [ 56 , 46 , 44 , 24 ] are widely used in software pipelines allowing for scanning source code for security bugs. Security experts write these tools’ queries by hand and must revise them as frameworks and codebases change. Each revision requires the expert to spot a missed vulnerability or a FP ( FP ). It needs to diagnose why the rule failed, and rewrite it without breaking what already works (Figure 1 shows one such repair). This process is rather slow and depends heavily on the expert. A narrow rule misses new patterns, and a broad one produces the FP that have long held back adoption [ 31 , 11 , 5 , 45 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 静态分析工具 [ 56 , 46 , 44 , 24 ] 被广泛用于软件流水线中，可扫描源代码以查找安全漏洞。 安全专家需要手工编写这些工具的查询规则，并随着框架和代码库的变化不断修订它们。 每次修订都要求专家发现一个被漏掉的漏洞或一个误报（FP）。 这需要诊断规则失败的原因，并在不破坏已有正确功能的前提下重写它（图 1 展示了一次这样的修复）。 这一过程相当缓慢，且严重依赖专家。 过窄的规则会漏掉新的模式，而过宽的规则则会产生长期阻碍其普及应用的误报 [ 31 , 11 , 5 , 45 ]。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has started to hand this labour to LLM , asking a model to read the code and report bugs directly [ 50 , 36 ] or to write rules from external inputs such as published CVE reports or fixing patches [ 52 , 28 , 37 ] . The first kind leaves little that can be reused in later scans, while the second ties its findings to previously documented vulnerabilities. We ask whether an LLM agent can, instead, maintain its own rules by observing where a rule fails, diagnosing why, and rewriting it, as a security engineer would.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的工作已经开始将这项劳动交给大语言模型，让模型直接阅读代码并报告漏洞 [50, 36]，或者根据已发布的 CVE 报告或修复补丁等外部输入编写规则 [52, 28, 37]。 第一类方式几乎没有留下可在后续扫描中复用的内容，而第二类方式则将其发现与先前已记录的漏洞绑定在一起。 我们提出这样的问题：一个基于大语言模型的智能体能否像安全工程师那样，通过观察规则在何处失效、诊断失效原因并重写规则，来维护自己的规则。

paragraphs.en: We present SESAA, an LLM agent that starts with no rules and builds a set of queries for the open-source analyzer Joern , which represents code as a searchable graph (Figure 2 ). The agent operates in rounds, editing its queries and running them over a body of code that no one has marked as vulnerable or safe.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SESAA，一个从零规则起步的 LLM 智能体，它为开源分析器 Joern 构建一组查询，该分析器将代码表示为可搜索的图（图 2）。 该智能体以轮次方式运行，编辑其查询并在一批未经任何人标记为易受攻击或安全的代码上运行这些查询。

paragraphs.en: A second LLM , the critic, reviews what the queries flagged, judges each finding as a likely bug or a false alarm, and points out places where it suspects a bug was missed. We call these judgments pseudo-labels, because they stand in for labels that no one supplies. The run keeps the set of queries that scores best on them, and no finding is ever checked against ground-truth labels. The result is an ordinary set of queries that an engineer can read, edit, and run without the agent (§ 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第二个大语言模型——评论者（critic）——会审查这些查询所标记的内容，判断每条发现是疑似缺陷还是误报，并指出它怀疑有缺陷被遗漏的地方。 我们将这些判断称为伪标签（pseudo-labels），因为它们代替了无人提供的标签。 运行过程会保留在这些伪标签上得分最高的一组查询，并且任何发现都不会对照真实标签进行检验。 最终得到的是一组普通的查询，工程师无需智能体即可阅读、编辑和运行它们（§ 2）。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are as follows. (1) SESAA, a framework where an agent develops and maintains detection queries by evolving them from a critic’s pseudo-labels, without ground-truth labels. (2) Evolved detectors that reach a mean F 1 F_{1} of 0.742 0.742{} over 8 8{} independent runs on the OWASP Benchmark for Python [ 41 ] , well above the default configurations of five widely used tools and comparable to CodeQL tuned with access to the labels. (3) A pilot study on real-world Python projects, in which queries written from code taken before a vulnerability was introduced flagged 10 of 19 later CVEs.

paragraphs.en: The remainder of the paper describes the system and its evolutionary loop (§ 2 ), details the evaluation setup (§ 4 ), reports results (§ 5 ), reviews related work (§ 6 ), discusses the mechanism and threats to validity (§ 7 , § 8 ), and concludes (§ 9 ).

paragraphs.en: Self-Evolving Static Analysis Agent (SESAA), pairs two roles, shown in Figure 2 . The agent writes and repairs detection queries, and the critic, a second LLM [ 63 ] , reviews what those queries report. Because no labels exist to say whether they are right, the critic judges each finding as a likely true or false positive and turns its doubts into tickets , concrete items for the agent to resolve, either a false alarm to remove or a suspected miss to close. Starting from an empty set of queries, the agent repeatedly commits a batch of edits, which we call a mutation , and one committed mutation together with the re-run that scores it makes up a generation . After a fixed budget of generations, the run returns the best-scoring suite (Algorithm 1 ). A security team can read, review, and run the suite independently of the agent, since it consists of ordinary code and has no dependency on an LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 自演化静态分析智能体（SESAA）包含两个角色，如图 2 所示。 智能体编写并修复检测查询，而评论者（一个第二 LLM [63]）则审查这些查询报告的内容。 由于没有标签来判断它们是否正确，评论者将每条发现判定为可能的真实告警或误报，并将其疑虑转化为工单，即供智能体解决的具体事项，可能是需要移除的误报，也可能是需要补上的疑似漏报。 从一个空的查询集合开始，智能体反复提交一批修改（我们称之为一次变异），而一次已提交的变异连同对其评分的重跑一起构成一代。 在固定预算的代数之后，运行会返回得分最高的查询套件（算法 1）。 安全团队可以独立于智能体阅读、审查并运行该套件，因为它由普通代码组成，不依赖任何 LLM。

paragraphs.en: Code Property Graph and Engine. We build on Joern [ 56 ] . Its CPG ( CPG ) merges syntax ( AST ( AST )), execution paths ( CFG ( CFG )), and data and control dependencies ( PDG ( PDG )) in one graph, so a single query can express the taint flows that injection vulnerabilities need. Every query is ordinary Scala, a general-purpose language the agent can edit directly. Additionally, it is open source with Python frontend, so the loop can run it repeatedly over the corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 代码属性图与引擎。 我们基于 Joern [ 56 ] 构建。 其代码属性图（CPG）将语法（AST（AST））、执行路径（CFG（CFG））以及数据和控制依赖（PDG（PDG））合并在一张图中，因此单个查询即可表达注入漏洞所需的污点流。 每个查询都是普通的 Scala 代码，这是一种智能体可以直接编辑的通用语言。 此外，它是开源的并带有 Python 前端，因此该循环可以在语料库上反复运行它。

paragraphs.en: Evolutionary Algorithm. The agent is a ReAct agent [ 59 ] , an LLM that alternates between reasoning and calling tools, and in each generation it acts on the critic’s diagnosis of where the current queries fail, which lists its tickets and coverage gaps (§ 2.1 ). The difficulty is that every repair risks damage elsewhere, the stability–plasticity dilemma [ 40 ] , since a query tightened to remove one false alarm may stop catching a real bug. Two things limit that risk. The run keeps the highest-fitness suite seen so far, so a bad mutation costs one generation and not the run, and the fitness in § 2.1 penalizes losing either precision or coverage. The repairs that hold up tend to capture why a flagged case is safe (i.e., it uses escaped input or a parameterized binding) rather than just narrowing which cases match, and the agent often records that rationale inline as a comment. Algorithm 1 gives the procedure.

paragraphs.en: The agent has seven tools, which fall into three groups. To act, it has a shell for running commands, a planning tool for deliberating between actions, and a query-deletion tool, and it ends each generation with a commit tool. To check its work, it has a corpus-evaluation tool that runs the current suite and returns the critic’s scored diagnosis, and a ticket tool for listing, reviewing, or dismissing false-positive and false-negative tickets. To consult its own history, it has an archive-inspection tool that reads prior generations’ suites.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体拥有七个工具，分为三组。 在行动方面，它有一个用于运行命令的 shell 工具、一个用于在行动之间进行权衡的规划工具，以及一个查询删除工具，并且它每次生成结束时都会使用提交工具。 为了检查自己的工作，它有一个语料库评估工具，用于运行当前测试套件并返回评审者的评分诊断，还有一个工单工具，用于列出、审查或驳回误报和漏报工单。 为了查阅自己的历史，它有一个归档检查工具，可以读取先前各代生成的测试套件。

paragraphs.en: The fitness must reward both precision and coverage without ground-truth labels. We call it pseudo-labeled : the critic judges each finding as a likely TP ( TP ) or FP from the surrounding code and context, and the suite’s fitness is aggregated from those judgments. The judgments are imperfect, since LLM remain unreliable at vulnerability reasoning [ 15 ] , so we measure the critic’s accuracy against the withheld labels (§ 5.2 ). The signal is therefore weak supervision from a pretrained model, not supervision-free.
paragraphs.zh: 适应度必须在没有真值标签的情况下同时奖励精确率和覆盖率。 我们将其称为伪标签：评判器根据周围代码和上下文将每条发现判定为可能的 TP（TP）或 FP（FP），而测试套件的适应度则由这些判定聚合而来。 这些判定并不完美，因为大语言模型在漏洞推理方面仍然不可靠 [15]，因此我们使用保留的标签来测量评判器的准确率（§5.2）。 因此，该信号来自预训练模型的弱监督，而非无监督。

paragraphs.en: False-negative tickets. FP tickets let the critic audit reported findings; FN ( FN ) tickets audit suspected misses, necessarily suspected since the critic never sees withheld labels (§ 4.6 reports how often these suspicions are confirmed). In each generation, the critic reviews a limited corpus subset, one vulnerability class at a time, and opens an FN ticket for each vulnerable-looking operation lacking a report. The agent resolves it by broadening or adding a query, or by contesting its vulnerability; the critic dismisses the ticket only if persuaded.

paragraphs.en: This example follows one early repair through the loop of § 2 . Like the SQL case in Figure 1 , the XPath-injection query relied on a coarse taint rule that could not tell why a construct was safe, so it raised FP on benign code.

paragraphs.en: This section describes our experimental setup: the evaluation corpus (§ 4.1 ), the baseline and agent configuration (§ 4.2 ), the models we use (§ 4.3 ), the experimental settings (§ 4.4 ), the metrics we use to evaluate the evolved detectors (§ 4.5 ), the protocol for analyzing the ticket mechanism (§ 4.6 ), the statistical tests (§ 4.7 ), and the introduction-time detection dataset (§ 4.8 ).

paragraphs.en: Generations and mutations. A mutation is the change the agent commits to the detector suite by writing, editing, or deleting Joern queries. A generation is one committed mutation, after which the suite is re-run and scored. Before committing, the agent may edit, measure the result, and read the critic’s feedback as many times as it likes.

paragraphs.en: Budget and determinism. Each generation’s react loop is bounded by a budget of 2000 messages, stated verbatim in the system prompt, after which the workspace is auto-committed even if the agent never explicitly commits. paragraphs.en: Baselines. We run a panel of widely used static and dynamic-analysis tools, CodeQL [ 24 ] , Semgrep [ 46 ] , Bandit [ 44 ] , Bearer [ 4 ] , and OWASP ZAP [ 42 ] , each in two configurations, scored with the official OWASP scorecard. The out-of-the-box configuration runs the community queries. CodeQL uses the python-security-extended suite with the GitHub Security Lab pack, and Semgrep uses the community packs p/python , p/flask , p/secrets , p/security-audit , and p/owasp-top-ten . The tuned configuration upgrades those community queries by having an LLM agent evolve them against the withheld labels. We run this tuning with three backbones (Claude Sonnet 5, Kimi-K2.5, GLM-5) at three window sizes (30, 60, 100 retained messages), for 9 tuning runs per tool. We report the best-performing queries from each tool’s 9-run panel, scored against the withheld OWASP labels after tuning. Unlike SESAA, which never observes the withheld labels at any point, the best-of-9 selection for every baseline tool is made with access to them. SESAA matching or exceeding a baseline tuned this way is therefore evidence under a harder information constraint, not a like-for-like accuracy race (§ 5.4 ).

paragraphs.en: We organize the evaluation into five settings, identified throughout as S1 – S5 and summarized visually in Figure 4 . paragraphs.en: One of SESAA’s central components is the ticket mechanism, which lets the critic flag a finding and the agent repair or contest it. We fix the protocol for one of two separate questions: whether the mechanism behaves as designed , meaning the critic’s judgment tracks ground truth and the agent acts on it. The other question, whether having the mechanism improves the detector , is answered separately by the S3 ablation (defined in § 4.4 ; results in § 5.1 ), and by the S4 ablation for FN tickets, which compare outcomes with the ticket surface on versus off across independent seeds.
paragraphs.zh: SESAA 的核心组件之一是工单机制，它允许批评者标记一个发现，并允许智能体对其进行修复或反驳。 我们针对两个独立问题之一固定了协议：该机制是否按设计运行，即批评者的判断是否追踪真实情况，且智能体是否据此采取行动。 另一个问题是拥有该机制是否能改进检测器，这由 S3 消融实验（定义见 § 4.4；结果见 § 5.1）以及针对 FN 工单的 S4 消融实验分别回答，这些实验在独立随机种子下比较开启与关闭工单机制时的结果。

sents.en: We fix the protocol for one of two separate questions: whether the mechanism behaves as designed , meaning the critic’s judgment tracks ground truth and the agent acts on it.
sents.zh: 我们针对两个独立问题之一固定了协议：该机制是否按设计运行，即批评者的判断是否追踪真实情况，且智能体是否据此采取行动。

sents.en: The other question, whether having the mechanism improves the detector , is answered separately by the S3 ablation (defined in § 4.4 ; results in § 5.1 ), and by the S4 ablation for FN tickets, which compare outcomes with the ticket surface on versus off across independent seeds.
sents.zh: 另一个问题是拥有该机制是否能改进检测器，这由 S3 消融实验（定义见 § 4.4；结果见 § 5.1）以及针对 FN 工单的 S4 消融实验分别回答，这些实验在独立随机种子下比较开启与关闭工单机制时的结果。

paragraphs.en: Checking whether a ticket is accurate requires knowing whether the finding behind it is a genuine FP , so we check every opened ticket and every repair made against the withheld labels. The critic opens a ticket for each finding it judges a FP . The agent may then repair the query or contest the ticket, and the critic accepts or rejects the contest. We label each ticketed finding as a genuine FP or a real vulnerability, judging both whether the critic’s ticket (and contest verdict) is correct, and whether the agent’s repair removed a genuine FP or destroyed a real detection.
paragraphs.zh: 判断某个工单是否准确，需要知道其背后的发现是否为真正的误报，因此我们将每个已开启的工单和每项修复都与留出的标注进行核对。 评审者会为它判定为误报的每个发现开启一个工单。 智能体随后可以修复查询或对工单提出异议，评审者则接受或拒绝该异议。 我们将每个被开启工单的发现标注为真正的误报或真实的漏洞，同时评判评审者的工单（及异议裁决）是否正确，以及智能体的修复是消除了真正的误报还是破坏了真实的检测。

paragraphs.en: The ticket mechanism setup raises three questions. First, whether a FP ticket actually points at a genuine FP . Second, whether repairs concentrate on the tickets the critic flagged rather than falling just as likely on anything else. Third, whether the critic’s precision estimate is systematically biased relative to the withheld ground truth. For each, we compute the null distribution by exact enumeration rather than a normal approximation. We compute Fisher’s exact test [ 18 ] for the first question (whether FP tickets are independent of ground-truth FP status), a one-sided hypergeometric test for the second (random draw versus selective response), and an exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test [ 54 , 23 ] for the third.
paragraphs.zh: 票据机制的设置引出了三个问题。 第一，某张 FP 票据是否确实指向一个真实的 FP。 第二，修复是否集中在 critic 标记的票据上，而不是像随机情况那样均匀落在其他任何地方。 第三，critic 的精确率估计相对于保留的真实标签是否存在系统性偏差。 针对每一个问题，我们都通过精确枚举而非正态近似来计算零分布。 对于第一个问题（FP 票据是否与真实 FP 状态独立），我们计算 Fisher 精确检验 [ 18 ]；对于第二个问题（随机抽取与选择性响应），使用单侧超几何检验；对于第三个问题，使用精确 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 [ 54 , 23 ]。

paragraphs.en: We perform two additional checks of the mechanism’s overall behavior. First, we test whether the critic’s fitness score tracks the withheld ground truth over the full run, using Pearson correlation with a t t -test on the coefficient [ 49 ] and Spearman correlation to assess rank agreement. Second, we test whether the critic’s judgment extends to the recall side by comparing the fraction of FN tickets that correspond to real vulnerabilities against the per-class base rate of a random file, using a one-sided Fisher exact test [ 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们对该机制的整体行为进行两项补充检查。 首先，我们检验评论者的适应度得分能否在整个运行过程中跟踪被保留的真实标签，使用皮尔逊相关系数并对该系数进行 t 检验 [49]，以及斯皮尔曼相关系数来评估秩一致性。 其次，我们通过将对应于真实漏洞的 FN 工单比例与单个随机文件的各类别基准率进行比较，检验评论者的判断能否延伸到召回一侧，采用单侧 Fisher 精确检验 [18]。

paragraphs.en: Bayesian supplement for the ablations. Each independent evolution run costs on the order of hundreds of dollars in API spend, so each ablation arm has only n = 5 n{=}5 seeds, small enough that a p p -value above 0.05 is easy to misread as “no effect” when it may just mean the test is underpowered (§ 8 ). As a supplement, we instead report a Bayesian estimate of each ablation’s standardized effect size, Cohen’s d d for ablation vs. S1 . We use a weakly informative prior, 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \mathcal{N}(0,1) , centered on no effect , updated against the observed d d and its standard error [ 27 ] via the standard Normal-Normal conjugate rule. This provides a posterior over the true effect size and, from it, the posterior probability that the true effect runs in the predicted, harmful, direction. The prior pulls each posterior back toward zero relative to the raw observed effect.
paragraphs.zh: 消融实验的贝叶斯补充分析。 每次独立的演化运行在 API 花费上约为数百美元，因此每个消融分支只有 n = 5 n{=}5 个种子，样本量小到 p p 值大于 0.05 很容易被误读为「无效应」，而它可能只意味着检验的统计功效不足（§ 8）。 作为补充，我们改为报告每个消融相对 S1 的标准化效应量的贝叶斯估计，即 Cohen's d d。 我们使用弱信息先验 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \mathcal{N}(0,1)，以无效应为中心，并通过标准正态-正态共轭规则，基于观测到的 d d 及其标准误进行更新 [27]。 这给出了真实效应量上的后验分布，并由此得到真实效应朝预测的、有害方向发展的后验概率。 相对于原始观测效应，该先验会把每个后验拉向零。

paragraphs.en: The S5 corpus enables us to evaluate whether queries developed on clean code catch a vulnerability at the moment it is introduced. We resolve this for CVEs in our real-world corpus via SZZ-style blame attribution [ 48 ] : for each fix commit we trace its changed lines backward through git blame to their introducing commit, with automatic escalation from shallow to full history when a boundary is hit.
paragraphs.zh: S5 语料库使我们能够评估在干净代码上开发的查询能否在漏洞被引入的那一刻将其捕获。 我们通过 SZZ 风格的追责归因 [48] 为现实世界语料库中的 CVE 解决这一问题：对每个修复提交，我们通过 git blame 将其变更的行向后追溯至引入这些行的提交，并在遇到边界时自动从浅层历史升级为完整历史。

paragraphs.en: For each S5 run, we evolve detectors on one pre-introduction tree, a repository snapshot captured immediately before a vulnerability-introducing commit was applied, testing whether agents can write proactive security queries on clean code that catch vulnerabilities once later introduced, without having seen any vulnerable examples. Pre-introduction trees contain no instance of the CVE they are tested on, providing no traditional training signal. Agents must instead identify security-sensitive code patterns, such as file I/O, SQL query construction, shell command execution, path manipulation, and HTML rendering, and write queries that flag potential violations based on best practices rather than concrete examples. The fitness function for pre-introduction evolution is F proactive = c ^ pattern × ( 1 − r ^ fp ) , F_{\text{proactive}}=\hat{c}_{\text{pattern}}\times(1-\hat{r}_{\text{fp}}), where c ^ pattern \hat{c}_{\text{pattern}} is the fraction of detected security-sensitive patterns covered by evolved queries, and r ^ fp \hat{r}_{\text{fp}} the critic-judged false-positive rate of the queries’ findings on the clean training corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每次 S5 运行，我们在一个引入前树上演化检测器——即在一个引入漏洞的提交被应用之前立即捕获的仓库快照——以测试智能体能否在干净代码上编写出主动的安全查询，从而捕捉之后才被引入的漏洞，且事先未见过任何漏洞示例。 引入前树不包含其所被测试的 CVE 的任何实例，因此不提供传统的训练信号。 智能体必须转而识别安全敏感的代码模式，例如文件 I/O、SQL 查询构造、shell 命令执行、路径操作和 HTML 渲染，并基于最佳实践而非具体示例编写能标记潜在违规的查询。 引入前演化的适应度函数为 F proactive = c ^ pattern × ( 1 − r ^ fp ) ，F_{\text{proactive}}=\hat{c}_{\text{pattern}}\times(1-\hat{r}_{\text{fp}})，其中 c ^ pattern \hat{c}_{\text{pattern}} 是演化查询所覆盖的已检测安全敏感模式的比例，而 r ^ fp \hat{r}_{\text{fp}} 是评论者对查询在干净训练语料上所发现结果的误报率判断。

paragraphs.en: We evolve detectors on each pre-introduction snapshot, then test the resulting suite against introduction cases, mimicking a project-specific SAST tool evolving continuously and flagging newly introduced code. A detection counts as a hit if the evolved suite fires on a finding matching the reported CVE. The resulting benchmark, 36 test cases spanning 19 CVEs across 12 projects, is released for evaluating any SAST tool on introduction-time recall.

paragraphs.en: We ask four questions of the evolved detectors. The first is whether detection queries can evolve from an empty start without ground-truth labels, and they can (§ 5.1 ). The second is whether the critic and its tickets behave as designed. The critic’s flags are enriched for real FP and the agent’s repairs follow them above chance (§ 5.2 ). The third is how the queries compare with mature tools (§ 5.4 ). The fourth, a pilot, is whether queries written on clean code catch vulnerabilities introduced later (§ 5.5 ).

Precision is the share of a suite’s alerts that are real, and recall is the share of the benchmark’s vulnerabilities it finds. The mean F 1 F_{1} , which balances the two, is 0.742 0.742{} , from a mean precision of 0.780 0.780{} and a mean recall of 0.734 0.734{} . The runs differ because the loop is stochastic and we do not control decoding settings, with a standard deviation of 0.084 0.084{} and a 95% confidence interval of [ 0.671 , 0.812 ] [0.671{},0.812{}] . Against the strongest baseline, 6 of 8 seeds exceed CodeQL’s F 1 F_{1} of 0.70 (Figure 4 ), and the other two fall below it, so the mean sits only modestly above the baseline and its interval overlaps CodeQL’s score.

paragraphs.en: The critic opens a ticket for each finding it doubts, and the agent either repairs the query so the finding disappears or contests the ticket (§ 2 ). We check this mechanism against the withheld ground truth across all 8 S1 seeds. We ask whether the critic flags findings that really are false alarms, whether the agent repairs those more often than chance would predict, and whether the critic’s estimate of its own precision is fair. Exact tests answer each in turn (§ 4.6 , § 4.7 ).

paragraphs.en: The critic opened a ticket for random.randbytes(32) generating a rememberMe session cookie, judging 256 bits of PRNG output sufficient with no attacker-controlled seed apparent. paragraphs.en: A detector that only beats an empty baseline is not useful in practice, so we compare against the tools practitioners already use. paragraphs.en: Previous RQs have focused on reactive detection. We now ask whether an agent in the same setting can write detectors that catch vulnerabilities proactively, at the moment they are introduced. We ask this as a question about the agent’s zero-shot reasoning, not about whether SESAA’s evolutionary fitness mechanism specifically drives it: the two come apart in this pilot, and we treat that separation as a finding in its own right.
paragraphs.zh: 前面的几个研究问题都侧重于被动式检测。 我们现在要问的是，在相同设定下，智能体能否编写出在漏洞被引入的那一刻就主动将其捕获的检测器。 我们将其作为一个关于智能体零样本推理能力的问题来提出，而不是关于 SESAA 的进化适应度机制是否具体驱动了这一点：在这项试点研究中，两者是可以区分开的，我们也将这种区分本身视为一项发现。

paragraphs.en: Across all 12 runs, evolved detectors caught 10 of 19 CVEs. Table 1 gives the full per-repository breakdown. 9 of the 10 catches came from a detector evolved on the same repository, out of 17 CVEs in trained repositories. litellm, the one repository without a training run, was missed on both of its CVEs, and keras, MobSF, llama_index, and changedetection.io caught none of their own CVEs. The remaining catch is a cross-repository transfer: pyload’s own detector missed its CVE while the open-webui and changedetection.io detectors both flagged it, direct evidence that a rule evolved on one codebase can generalize to a vulnerability pattern in an entirely different one.
paragraphs.zh: 在全部 12 次运行中，进化出的检测器捕获了 19 个 CVE 中的 10 个。 表 1 给出了按仓库划分的完整明细。10 个捕获中有 9 个来自在同一仓库上进化出的检测器，而已训练仓库中共有 17 个 CVE。litellm 是唯一没有训练运行的仓库，它的两个 CVE 均未被发现；而 keras、MobSF、llama_index 和 changedetection.io 则未能捕获各自的任何 CVE。 剩下的一个捕获是跨仓库迁移：pyload 自身的检测器漏掉了它的 CVE，而 open-webui 和 changedetection.io 的检测器都将其标记出来，这直接证明在一个代码库上进化出的规则可以泛化到完全不同的代码库中的漏洞模式。

paragraphs.en: SESAA sits between several ways of finding software vulnerabilities, and inherits from each without fully belonging to any of them. Static analyzers such as Joern [ 56 , 55 ] , CodeQL [ 24 ] , Semgrep [ 46 ] , and Infer [ 6 ] expose programmable queries over syntax, control flow, and data flow, and stay deterministic and explainable only as long as those queries keep up with how languages and frameworks actually change, a maintenance burden that grows with deployment scale [ 5 ] . SESAA keeps that same deterministic query as its output, but rewrites it continuously, guided by a critic’s pseudo-labels rather than a human maintainer.
paragraphs.zh: SESAA 位于多种发现软件漏洞的方法之间，从每一种方法中有所继承，却又不完全属于其中任何一种。 像 Joern [ 56 , 55 ]、CodeQL [ 24 ]、Semgrep [ 46 ] 和 Infer [ 6 ] 这样的静态分析器，在语法、控制流和数据流之上提供可编程查询，并且只有在这些查询能够跟得上语言和框架的实际变化时，才能保持确定性与可解释性，而这一维护负担会随着部署规模的扩大而增长 [ 5 ]。 SESAA 保留了同样确定性的查询作为其输出，但会持续地重写该查询，其引导来自评论者（critic）的伪标签，而非人工维护者。

paragraphs.en: A parallel line of work sidesteps rule maintenance by learning to classify vulnerable code directly: Devign [ 64 ] , SySeVR [ 38 ] , ReVeal [ 7 ] , LineVul [ 19 ] , and pretrained encoders such as GraphCodeBERT [ 26 ] all reach strong predictive accuracy this way, but the result is a classifier rather than an analysis, and what these models learn stays in their weights rather than in a query a security engineer can read, edit, or run on its own.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条并行的研究路线通过直接学习对易受攻击代码进行分类来规避规则维护问题：Devign [64]、SySeVR [38]、ReVeal [7]、LineVul [19]，以及 GraphCodeBERT [26] 等预训练编码器都以这种方式达到了很强的预测准确率，但其结果是一个分类器而非一种分析，而且这些模型学到的东西停留在其权重之中，而不是留在安全工程师能够阅读、编辑或独立运行的查询里。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents for software security. LLM agents push further in the same direction, applying language models directly to vulnerability detection [ 22 , 15 , 50 , 16 ] , code review [ 12 ] , repair [ 34 ] , exploit generation [ 17 ] , and penetration testing [ 14 ] , with agentic tool use adding iterative execution feedback [ 59 , 58 , 62 ] ; Codebadger, for instance, exposes Joern ’s CPG to an agent through slicing and taint-tracking tools rather than raw queries [ 36 ] . Here the model is doing the analysis itself, on every repository and every run, so little of what it learns carries over to the next one, even where a second model checks its work, as in recent verifier-style vulnerability discovery [ 29 ] . SESAA also uses a second model this way, as an LLM -as-judge [ 63 ] , but points the resulting signal at the query rather than the verdict, so what persists across runs is the analyzer rather than a transcript.
paragraphs.zh: 用于软件安全的 LLM 智能体。 LLM 智能体在相同方向上更进一步，直接将语言模型应用于漏洞检测 [22, 15, 50, 16]、代码审查 [12]、修复 [34]、漏洞利用生成 [17] 和渗透测试 [14]，并借助智能体式的工具使用引入迭代式执行反馈 [59, 58, 62]；例如，Codebadger 通过切片和污点追踪工具而非原始查询，向智能体暴露 Joern 的 CPG [36]。 在这里，模型在每次对每个仓库运行时都要亲自进行分析，因此它学到的东西几乎无法延续到下一次运行，即使在近期验证器式的漏洞发现 [29] 中有第二个模型检查其工作也是如此。 SESAA 也以这种方式使用第二个模型，作为 LLM 充当裁判 [63]，但它将由此产生的信号指向查询而非判定结果，因而在各次运行之间得以延续的是分析器本身，而非一份记录。

paragraphs.en: LLM-generated analysis rules. A closer line of work has LLM write the rules themselves. QLCoder synthesizes CodeQL queries from CVE metadata and vulnerable and patched code, refining each query with execution feedback [ 52 ] . Irsan et al. generate CodeQL queries from National Vulnerability Database entries [ 28 ] , and MoCQ refines LLM-written vulnerability patterns against symbolic validation feedback [ 37 ] . These systems take their supervision from outside, as CVE reports, patches, or pattern specifications, whereas SESAA takes it from a critic’s pseudo-labels over unlabeled code and keeps evolving the same detector across generations.
paragraphs.zh: 由大语言模型生成的分析规则。 更接近的一项工作让大语言模型自己编写规则。 QLCoder 从 CVE 元数据以及易受攻击代码和已修补代码合成 CodeQL 查询，并利用执行反馈对每条查询进行优化 [ 52 ] 。 Irsan 等人从美国国家漏洞数据库条目生成 CodeQL 查询 [ 28 ] ，而 MoCQ 则依据符号验证反馈来优化大语言模型编写的漏洞模式 [ 37 ] 。 这些系统的监督来自外部，例如 CVE 报告、补丁或模式规范，而 SESAA 的监督则来自评判智能体对未标注代码给出的伪标签，并让同一个检测器在各代之间持续演化。

paragraphs.en: Self-improving software engineering agents. Reflexion [ 47 ] , Self-Refine [ 39 ] , TextGrad [ 61 ] , OPRO [ 57 ] , and GEPA [ 1 ] face a related problem from the agent’s side: they get better at reasoning through refined prompts, strategies, or policies, but that improvement stays embedded in the model pipeline and inherits continual learning’s stability-plasticity dilemma [ 25 , 40 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进的软件工程智能体。 Reflexion [ 47 ]、Self-Refine [ 39 ]、TextGrad [ 61 ]、OPRO [ 57 ] 和 GEPA [ 1 ] 从智能体一侧面临一个相关问题：它们通过精炼的提示词、策略或策略在推理上变得更强，但这种改进仍然停留在模型流水线内部，并继承了持续学习的稳定性-可塑性困境 [ 25 , 40 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Evolutionary search and neuroevolution. The archive-and-mutation loop underneath SESAA is closer to genetic programming’s evolution of executable programs [ 32 ] and neuroevolution’s search beyond fixed parameters [ 20 , 13 ] , both of which justify branching, non-greedy search over an irregular landscape. Recent surveys extend that idea to LLM -based systems [ 21 ] : Meta-Harness evolves the harness around a fixed model [ 35 ] , and HarnessX treats the harness itself, prompts, tools, memory, control flow, as a composable artefact [ 9 ] . SESAA shares the premise that the machinery around a model is worth evolving, but points it at the analysis logic itself, selected by a critic-pseudo-labeled signal that needs no ground truth, with a feedback step that draws on Reflexion, Self-Refine [ 47 , 39 ] , and GEPA’s critique/generation split [ 1 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 进化搜索与神经进化。 SESAA 底层的存档与变异循环更接近遗传编程对可执行程序的进化 [ 32 ] 以及神经进化超越固定参数的搜索 [ 20 , 13 ] ，二者都为在不规则地形上进行分支式、非贪婪搜索提供了依据。 近期的综述将这一思想扩展到基于大语言模型的系统 [ 21 ] ：Meta-Harness 在固定模型的基础上进化其测试装置（harness）[ 35 ] ，而 HarnessX 则把测试装置本身——提示、工具、记忆、控制流——视为可组合的构件 [ 9 ] 。 SESAA 认同「模型周围的机制值得进化」这一前提，但将其指向分析逻辑本身，其选择由无需真实标签的评论者伪标签信号驱动，其反馈步骤则借鉴了 Reflexion、Self-Refine [ 47 , 39 ] 以及 GEPA 的评论/生成分离机制 [ 1 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The critic is the agent’s only source of feedback. The tickets are enriched for genuine FP , and the agent repairs those more often than chance would predict. Both effects are significant across seeds. The outcome ablations point the same way. Removing the critic, the FP tickets, or the FN tickets each lowers the mean F 1 F_{1} , and the Bayesian estimate puts 93% posterior probability on the FP -ticket removal being harmful. These differences are not individually significant, so we read them as a consistent direction whose size a larger campaign would pin down. At the same time, the agent writes strong detectors without the critic. The critic’s contribution is therefore a refinement on top of a capable agent, and removing it trades precision for recall.
paragraphs.zh: 评审器是智能体唯一的反馈来源。 票据针对真实假阳性进行了增强，智能体对这些票据的修复频率高于随机概率的预期。 这两种效应在不同种子下均显著。 结果消融实验也指向同一方向。 移除评审器、假阳性票据或假阴性票据中的任一项都会降低平均 F 1 F_{1}，且贝叶斯估计显示移除假阳性票据有害的后验概率为 93%。 这些差异单独来看并不显著，因此我们将其解读为一个方向一致的结果，其效应大小将由更大规模的实验确定。 与此同时，智能体在没有评审器的情况下也能编写出强大的检测器。 因此，评审器的贡献是在一个能力完备的智能体之上进行的精炼，移除它会以牺牲精确率换取召回率。

paragraphs.en: The ticket tests should be read the same way. Ticketed findings are more likely than other findings to be genuine FP , and the agent repairs those more often than chance, but they establish enrichment and not accuracy: 97 of the 665 findings the agent solved were real vulnerabilities removed by mistake. The FN tickets show the same limit, since a pooled 61% of them point at a genuine miss. The contest step lets the agent push back on a wrong verdict, as in the randbytes example of § 5.2 , but it relies on a single critic. A natural next step is to separate the judgments, for example with independent critics for FP and FN review that must agree before a ticket is opened, to make this feedback more reliable.
paragraphs.zh: 工单测试也应以同样的方式解读。 被开成工单的发现比其他发现更可能是真实的误报（FP），智能体修复这些工单的频率也高于随机水平，但它们只能证明富集性而非准确性：智能体解决的 665 项发现中有 97 项是因误判而被错误移除的真实漏洞。 漏报（FN）工单显示出同样的局限，因为汇总来看其中 61% 指向真实的遗漏。 竞赛环节允许智能体对错误的判定提出异议，如 §5.2 中 randbytes 的例子所示，但它依赖于单一的评审者。 一个自然的后续步骤是分离这些判断，例如为误报和漏报审查分别设置独立的评审者，且必须在开立工单前达成一致，以使这种反馈更加可靠。

paragraphs.en: For a security team, the practical result is that the maintenance loop can run without labels. A team with a new framework or a codebase no one has labeled could point the agent at it and review the queries it returns, instead of writing them. We tested this on a labeled benchmark and a small pilot, so the claim is that the loop can work without labels, not that it has been shown to work on unlabeled production code.
paragraphs.zh: 对安全团队而言，实际效果是维护循环可以在没有标签的情况下运行。 拥有新框架或无人标注过代码库的团队，可以让智能体指向该代码库并审查它返回的查询，而不是自己编写这些查询。 我们在一个带标签的基准测试和一个小型试点上进行了验证，因此我们的结论是该循环可以在没有标签的情况下工作，而不是说它已被证明能在无标签的生产代码上有效运行。

paragraphs.en: Two properties of the output matter for that use. First, the cost is paid once and not on every scan. A run consumes substantial model tokens (§ 5.3 ), but the suite it returns is ordinary code with no model dependency, so scanning afterwards is as cheap as running any Joern query set, unlike approaches that call a model on every repository and every run. Second, the suite can be reviewed. The agent often records why a flagged case is safe in an inline comment (§ 3 ), so an engineer can audit a change, keep it, or revert it, which keeps a person in the loop without asking them to write the rule.
paragraphs.zh: 该用途关注输出的两个特性。 首先，成本只支付一次，而不是每次扫描都要支付。 一次运行会消耗大量的模型 token（§ 5.3），但它返回的测试套件是没有任何模型依赖的普通代码，因此之后的扫描就像运行任何 Joern 查询集一样便宜，这与那些在每次运行时都对每个仓库调用模型的方法不同。 其次，测试套件可以被审查。 智能体通常会在行内注释中记录某个被标记的案例为何是安全的（§ 3），因此工程师可以审计一项更改、保留它或撤销它，这既让人员保持在回路中，又不需要他们亲自编写规则。

paragraphs.en: The agent’s only memory across generations is a flat, read-only archive of earlier suites. Structured memory [ 53 , 10 ] could let it reuse what it has learned instead of re-deriving it after each repair. Replacing the stronger critic with the agent’s own model would also show how much of the signal comes from the critic’s prior knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体跨代际的唯一记忆是一个扁平的、只读的早期测试套件存档。 结构化记忆 [ 53 , 10 ] 可以让它复用已学到的内容，而不是在每次修复后重新推导。 用智能体自己的模型替换更强的评判者，也能显示有多少信号来自评判者的先验知识。

paragraphs.en: We organize the threats along four axes, and for each we point to the evidence in § 5 that bounds it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将威胁归纳为四个维度，并针对每个维度指出第 5 节中界定该威胁的证据。

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. The agent explores the corpus directly, so some of its gains may come from its own reading of the code and not from the critic’s signal. The S2 ablation bounds this, since it keeps the agent’s tools and corpus and removes only the critic, and it lands within S1 ’s spread on F 1 F_{1} , so the outcome data cannot separate the two. The critic is also a stronger model than the agent it supervises (§ 4.3 ), so some of what we attribute to pseudo-labeling could be the critic’s own prior knowledge leaking through its judgments. Isolating that requires a same-model agent and critic, a local-context-only critic, and a category-blind critic, which we have not run at the cost § 5.3 reports. For the real-world pilot, the ground truth is the introducing commit found by SZZ attribution, which attributes lines to their last modification and can misplace the true introduction.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 智能体直接探索语料库，因此其部分收益可能来自它自己对代码的阅读，而非来自评估器的信号。 S2 消融实验对此进行了界定，因为它保留了智能体的工具和语料库，仅移除了评估器，并且其结果落在 S1 在 F_{1} 上的波动范围内，因此结果数据无法将二者区分开来。 评估器也是比它所监督的智能体更强的模型（§ 4.3），因此我们归因于伪标签的部分收益，可能是评估器自身先验知识通过其判断泄露出来的结果。 分离这一因素需要一个与评估器同模型的智能体、一个仅使用局部上下文的评估器，以及一个对类别不可知的评估器，而我们尚未以 § 5.3 报告的成本运行这些实验。 在真实世界试点中，真实标签是由 SZZ 归因找到的引入提交，该方法将代码行归因于其最后一次修改，可能会错误地定位真正的引入点。

paragraphs.en: External validity. We evaluate one language (Python) and one model pair, and the OWASP benchmark is synthetic, so we do not claim the results carry to other languages, model families, or real-world development. The real-world pilot offers some evidence for transfer to organically written code, but it covers 12 projects and 19 CVEs. Joern ’s CPG construction is bound by available RAM, so scaling to large repositories or other program representations is open, and a single S1 run already consumes a substantial number of Claude Sonnet 5 tokens (§ 5.3 ). We did not study other budgets, so we cannot say how detector quality or cost scale with a smaller or larger one.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度。 我们只评估了一种语言（Python）和一对模型，且 OWASP 基准是合成的，因此我们不声称结果可以推广到其他语言、模型家族或真实世界的开发中。 真实世界的试点为迁移到自然编写的代码提供了一些证据，但它仅涵盖 12 个项目和 19 个 CVE。 Joern 的 CPG 构建受可用内存限制，因此扩展到大型仓库或其他程序表示仍是未解决的问题，而且单次 S1 运行已经消耗大量 Claude Sonnet 5 的 token（§ 5.3）。 我们没有研究其他预算，因此无法说明检测器质量或成本在更小或更大预算下如何变化。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. The pseudo-labeled fitness is a proxy for the ground-truth F 1 F_{1} we cannot observe during search, and its two halves are each imperfect. “Label-free” means the agent never sees which files are vulnerable, not that the corpus offers no prior structure. The target taxonomy T T is fixed (for OWASP, the benchmark’s own CWE ( CWE ) categories), and Joern ’s CPG exposes taint-relevant primitives that narrow what a plausible query can look like. Both models were also pretrained on public code and vulnerability discussion that may include the OWASP style, and we did not test the critic under semantic-preserving transformations that remove those cues. Some reported accuracy may therefore reflect benchmark recognition and not general detection ability. Agent and critic also come from one model family, which may make the critic favor output that resembles its own [ 43 ] . Youden’s J J for the evolved detector uses an approximation of TN that upper-bounds it, so it is not on equal footing with the baselines’ J J . The evidence therefore supports a narrower claim than “without labels.” The agent has no access to the withheld answer key, on a benchmark whose taxonomy and surface patterns are not entirely unfamiliar to the search.
paragraphs.zh: 构念效度。 伪标签适应度是我们在搜索过程中无法观测到的真实 F 1 F_{1} 的替代指标，其两个组成部分各自都不完善。「无标签」指的是智能体永远看不到哪些文件存在漏洞，而不是说语料库没有任何先验结构。 目标分类体系 T T 是固定的（对于 OWASP，即该基准自身的 CWE ( CWE ) 类别），且 Joern 的 CPG 暴露了与污点相关的原语，这限制了合理查询的可能形态。 两个模型还都在可能包含 OWASP 风格的公开代码和漏洞讨论上进行了预训练，而且我们未在去除这些线索的保义变换下测试评审模型。 因此，部分报告的准确率可能反映的是对基准的辨识，而非通用的检测能力。 智能体与评审模型来自同一模型家族，这可能使评审模型偏向于认可与自己相似的输出 [ 43 ] 。 进化检测器的 Youden's J J 使用了对 TN 的一种上界近似，因此它与基线的 J J 并不处于同等地位。 因此，证据支持的是一个比「无标签」更窄的结论。智能体无法访问被扣留的答案密钥，而该基准的分类体系和表层模式对搜索而言并非完全陌生。

paragraphs.en: Conclusion validity. The loop is stochastic, and ground-truth F 1 F_{1} varies across independent runs (§ 5.1 ), with the charted run sitting above the mean. Each ablation has five seeds, which bounds the aggregate metric and does not show the mechanisms are inert, and a conventionally powered campaign would need roughly ten times as many, which is why we add a Bayesian effect-size estimate. The ablation tests are not corrected for multiplicity, and F 1 F_{1} is the single primary metric. The ticket tests are significant across all 8 seeds, but they come from one benchmark and one model pair, so they establish that the critic tracks ground truth in this setting and not in general.
paragraphs.zh: 结论效度。 该循环是随机的，真实值 F 1 F_{1} 在独立运行之间会有变化（§ 5.1），图表所绘的运行结果高于均值。 每项消融实验有五个随机种子，这界定了聚合指标，但并不能表明这些机制不起作用；而一项具有常规统计功效的实验大约需要十倍于此的种子数量，这也是我们补充贝叶斯效应量估计的原因。 消融检验未做多重性校正，且 F 1 F_{1} 是唯一的primary指标。 工单检验在全部 8 个种子上均显著，但它们来自单一基准和单一模型对，因此只能证明评论器在此设定下跟踪真实值，而非普遍成立。

paragraphs.en: We asked whether a static-analysis rule set can evolve and repair itself without ground-truth labels, the way a security engineer revises a set of queries after spotting what it missed. Our results support three findings, with the limits stated below. First, an agent can write competitive queries from scratch. They reach a mean F 1 F_{1} of 0.742 0.742{} on the OWASP Benchmark for Python, ahead of five widely used tools’ default configurations and in the same range as CodeQL once tuned with the labels SESAA never gets. Second, the critic’s pseudo-labels carry a real but imperfect signal. Its tickets are enriched for FP and the agent’s repairs track them above chance, although some repairs remove real vulnerabilities. Removing the critic or either ticket type lowers the mean F 1 F_{1} in the direction the design predicts. Third, an agent reasoning over clean code can write rules that catch later vulnerabilities. Queries evolved on clean code alone caught 10 of 19 vulnerabilities at the moment they were introduced. We hope these findings help reframe the security scanner from a static tool into a system that keeps itself current as the code it watches keeps changing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探究了一个静态分析规则集能否在没有真值标注的情况下自我演化和修复，就像安全工程师在发现规则漏报之后修订一套查询那样。 我们的结果支持三项发现，其局限性将在下文说明。 第一，智能体能够从零开始编写具有竞争力的查询。 这些查询在 Python 版 OWASP Benchmark 上达到 0.742{} 的平均 F 1 F_{1}，超过五个广泛使用的工具的默认配置，并在与 CodeQL 相同的区间内——而 CodeQL 是用 SESAA 从未获得的标注调优过的。 第二，批评者的伪标签携带着真实但不完美的信号。 其工单在误报方面被富集，智能体的修复以高于随机水平的方式追踪这些工单，尽管部分修复移除了真实漏洞。 移除批评者或任一工单类型都会使平均 F 1 F_{1} 向设计所预测的方向下降。 第三，智能体通过在干净代码上推理，能够编写出捕获后续漏洞的规则。 仅在干净代码上演化出的查询，在 19 个漏洞中的 10 个被引入的当时就捕获了它们。 我们希望这些发现有助于将安全扫描器从一个静态工具重塑为一个随着所监控代码不断变化而保持自身更新的系统。

paragraphs.en: Each generational agent is a ReAct loop equipped with the six tools below (seven when the FP -ticket mechanism is enabled, § 2.1 ) and no other side-effecting capabilities. paragraphs.en: Compiles and runs all custom detectors over the full corpus ( ∼ \sim 2 min) and returns a per-query findings summary together with the critic’s qualitative feedback (coverage gaps, false-positive patterns). It measures the current suite but does not commit it or end the generation. The agent may call it repeatedly, revising detectors between calls, before deciding the suite is ready (§ 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在完整语料库上编译并运行所有自定义检测器（约 2 分钟），并返回逐查询的检测结果摘要以及评审者的定性反馈（覆盖缺口、误报模式）。 它只度量当前检测器套件，但不会提交该套件，也不会结束生成过程。 智能体可以反复调用它，在两次调用之间修改检测器，然后才判定套件是否就绪（§ 4.2）。

Template variables (e.g. {gen} , {parent_id} ) are filled at runtime.
paragraphs.zh: 我们逐字复现定义系统行为的四个提示词：三个面向智能体的提示词（系统提示词、每次生成提示词，以及注入回智能体的评论者反馈），外加评论者的精确率判定提示词，该提示词计算适应度信号中精确率那一半。 模板变量（例如 {gen}、{parent_id}）在运行时填充。

paragraphs.en: The system prompt establishes the agent’s role, workspace layout, available tools, and the measure/refine/commit loop; § 4.2 describes the same mechanism in prose.
paragraphs.zh: 系统提示词确立了智能体的角色、工作区布局、可用工具以及 measure/refine/commit 循环；§ 4.2 以文字形式描述了同一机制。

paragraphs.en: Each generation receives this prompt, which defines the fitness function, scoring insights, valid vulnerability types, the parent workspace, and the detector-writing workflow with syntax constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 每一代都会收到这个提示词，它定义了适应度函数、洞察评分、有效的漏洞类型、父工作区，以及带有语法约束的检测器编写工作流。

paragraphs.en: After each evaluation, the critic returns a structured summary injected into the agent’s context to guide the next mutation.
paragraphs.zh: 每次评估后，评估器会返回一个结构化摘要，该摘要会被注入智能体的上下文中，以指导下一次变异。

paragraphs.en: The precision half of the fitness signal is produced by an LLM judge. For each detector group (the findings emitted by one .sc query), the critic samples a few representative findings spanning distinct files and asks the model to count how many are genuinely exploitable; the group’s precision is the fraction judged real, and overall precision is the mean across groups. Sampling scales with group size (all findings if ≤ 5 \leq 5 , up to 8 8 for medium groups, 5 5 for large groups), and unchanged findings are cached to keep scoring deterministic across runs.
paragraphs.zh: 精确率部分的适应度信号由一个 LLM 评判模型生成。 对于每个检测器组（由一条 .sc 查询发出的所有发现），评判模型会抽取若干跨越不同文件的代表性发现，并要求模型统计其中有多少个是真正可利用的；该组的精确率即被判定为真实的比例，整体精确率则是各组精确率的均值。 抽样数量随组规模缩放（若发现数 ≤ 5 ≤ 5 则全部评估，中等规模的组最多抽取 8 8 个，大规模的组抽取 5 5 个），且未发生变化的发现会被缓存，以保证评分在不同运行之间是确定性的。
